=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 190 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The skip predicate compares `status_bucket == "working"`. If the claude-code-remote `list_sessions` result omits `status_bucket` for any session, the equality is `None == "working"` which is False, bypassing the working-bucket safeguard.
  WHY: A session actively doing work — but whose `status_bucket` field is missing from the listing — could be selected and archived even though the cleanup should leave it alone. The primary safeguards (the title match and the label check) still protect against the realistic case because a working session does not carry the "blocked on issue" title and the source issue still carries `ai:claude-blocked`.
